title: Transformers
page_title: Transformers | Cambridge (CIE) IGCSE Co-ordinated Sciences (Double Award) Revision Notes 2023

blocks.md:
- A **transformer** is a device used to **change **the size of an **alternating voltage **or *current*

  - This is achieved using the *generator effect*

- A basic transformer consists of:

  - a **primary coil**
  - a** secondary coil**
  - a **soft** **iron core**
- Iron is used because it is easily **magnetised**

blocks.alt: Structure of a Transformer, downloadable IGCSE & GCSE Physics revision notes

blocks.md: ***A simple transformer is made up of a primary coil and a secondary coil wound on a soft iron core***

- A transformer consists of a **primary **and **secondary **coil

  - The primary coil is the **first** coil
  - The secondary coil is the **second** coil

- A **step-up** transformer:

  - increases the **voltage** of a power source `(V_ s greater than V_ p)`
  - has **more turns** on the secondary coil than on the primary coil `(N_ s greater than N_ p)`
***A step-up transformer has more turns on the secondary coil which increases the size of the voltage***

- A **step-down** transformer:

  - decreases the **voltage** of a power source `(V_ s less than V_ p)`
  - has** fewer turns** on the secondary coil than on the primary coil `(N_ s less than N_ p)`
***A step-up transformer has fewer turns on the secondary coil which decreases the size of the voltage***
